elements.name: young passenger seen from behind at frame edge with shoulder and turned head

wrong_setting: The landscape reads as an alpine conifer forest rather than the Ethiopian highlands, and the vehicle interior looks more like an old train carriage than a country bus.
anatomy: The reference sheet's three turnaround poses have been copied into the scene as three separate standing figures, all the same character, with the same jacket, backpack and trousers. The front and back figures also have different trouser colours.
notes: Regenerate as one Ethiopian passenger seen from behind at the frame edge, seated with a backpack on his knees, looking out the bus window at highland slopes, with no duplicated turnaround figures in the scene.
